title: Oceanic Ukrainian Tuna Stew
description: A romantic Ukrainian dish featuring tuna, flambe, and a glassy-jelly texture. This vegan-friendly stew is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Combine the tuna steaks, glass noodles, and dried mushrooms in the hot pot vessel.
Heat 1 tablespoon of vegan vegetable oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegan Worcestershire sauce and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the hot pot vessel to the pan and stir to combine.
Flamb9 the mixture by lighting the vodka and tilting the pan to ignite the mixture.
Cook for 2 minutes, then stir in the tahini, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped fresh parsley and dill to the hot pot vessel and stir to combine.
Simmer the stew for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
